# `candid jobs`

Curate open jobs and feed the tracker.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid jobs [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `curate` | Discover jobs, score them, save the best as 'saved'. |
| `refresh` | Re-run curation; report only new jobs. |
| `list` | Show the curated pipeline (status=saved). |


### `candid jobs curate`

Discover jobs, score them, save the best as 'saved'.

```
usage: python -m candid jobs curate [-h] --role ROLE [--location LOCATION] [--remote] [--level LEVEL] [--limit LIMIT] [--sources [SOURCES ...]] [--days DAYS] [--min-score MIN_SCORE]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--role` `ROLE` | Wanted title, e.g. "Data Scientist" (required) |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | - |
| `--remote` | - |
| `--level` `LEVEL` | entry|junior|mid|senior|lead|staff|principal |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | (default: 15) |
| `--sources` `SOURCES` | subset of: arbeitnow remoteok |
| `--days` `DAYS` | Only postings from the last N days (unparseable dates are kept) |
| `--min-score` `MIN_SCORE` | Only save to tracker when match score >= N (default 0 = off) |


### `candid jobs refresh`

Re-run curation; report only new jobs.

```
usage: python -m candid jobs refresh [-h] --role ROLE [--location LOCATION] [--remote] [--level LEVEL] [--limit LIMIT] [--sources [SOURCES ...]] [--days DAYS] [--min-score MIN_SCORE]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--role` `ROLE` | (required) |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | - |
| `--remote` | - |
| `--level` `LEVEL` | - |
| `--limit` `LIMIT` | (default: 15) |
| `--sources` `SOURCES` | - |
| `--days` `DAYS` | Only postings from the last N days (unparseable dates are kept) |
| `--min-score` `MIN_SCORE` | Only save to tracker when match score >= N (default 0 = off) |


### `candid jobs list`

Show the curated pipeline (status=saved).

```
usage: python -m candid jobs list [-h] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print the curated job list as JSON (for scripting) |
